title: Uruguayan Bread Crumble
description: A sweet and indulgent bread crumble dessert inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, featuring a crunchy topping and a soft bread base.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss bread cubes with melted butter until evenly coated.
Transfer bread mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix crumbled pastry topping with brown sugar until well combined.
Spread pastry mixture evenly over bread cubes.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until topping is golden brown and bread is toasted.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
